title: braincoder: A package for fitting encoding models to neural data and decoding stimulus features
description:
braincoder is a Python package for fitting encoding models to neural data (currently fMRI) and inverting them to decode stimulus features from brain activity. Built on TensorFlow and TensorFlow Probability, it is GPU-accelerated and supports trial-wise Bayesian decoding. It computes coding-precision profiles numerically from fitted tuning curves, and provides a unified workflow from stimulus handling and HRF convolution to model fitting and decoding.
